$comment: Public business facts for Constant Labs and its websites. This file contains service descriptions and contact details; commercial pricing is shared separately.

brand.name: Constant Labs
brand.description: Dubai software and AI studio. We build AI agents, websites, custom software and SEO systems for businesses in the UAE and the GCC, in Arabic and English.

licence.authority: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET)

offers.name: AI agents
offers.summary: An AI agent that does one job inside your business: answering customers on WhatsApp, booking appointments, qualifying leads, checking documents, following up invoices. Bilingual Arabic and English.

offers.name: Websites
offers.summary: A custom website built to get found, with mobile-first design and Google Maps setup.

offers.name: SEO and AI search
offers.nameAr: تحسين محركات البحث والبحث بالذكاء الاصطناعي
offers.summary: Bilingual SEO, local SEO and AI-search visibility (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) for GCC businesses.

offers.name: Custom software
offers.summary: Web and mobile apps, dashboards, internal tools, system and ERP integrations, built around how your team works.

offers.name: AI training for teams
offers.summary: Hands-on AI training built around your team's actual roles, in Arabic and English, on site in Dubai or online.

offers.name: AI readiness audit
offers.summary: A written audit of where AI fits in your business, with a 30/60/90-day plan.

terms.guarantees: Project scope, delivery terms and commercial details are agreed directly before work starts.
